Class BDDDomain<T>

java.lang.Object
org.batfish.BDDDomain<T>
public final class BDDDomain<T> extends Object
Class that wraps a BDDInteger around a finite collection of values and provides an API for dealing directly with the values.

    • getIsValidConstraint

    • addValue

      public void addValue(T value)
      Adds a value to this domain without changing the underlying BDD variable assignment.

      This is only possible when the number of values does not exceed the current bit encoding. If adding the value would require more bits (i.e., the value count passes a 2^k boundary), an IllegalStateException is thrown and the caller must rebuild the domain instead.

      Parameters:
      value - the value to add
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if adding the value would require more BDD variables

    • numBits
